premise: The complete-series reference is the maximum over all concentrations of the same masked DIV-mean effect, so a design whose measured three points (or measured four points after the added dose) already give effect >= 3 is reference-active (equality active). Releasing it as active cannot be wrong. Gate: every calibration and test design with measured_only >= 3 and every branch with measured4 >= 3 has truth active (0); otherwise the run stops.

definitions.three_point_rules: anchorboost, measured_only, loglinear: crc_obs of risk_upgrade amendment 004. A design with measured_only >= 3 is released with call active; any other design is released iff its exact margin > lambda; lambda is the first grid value with (sum_g L_g + 1)/(n_cal + 1) <= 1/10 for L_g(lambda) = (1/D_g) * sum over the group designs with measured_only < 3 of 1(margin > lambda) 1(call != truth); exact rational arithmetic.
definitions.observed_active: unchanged; it equals the lane-only policy.
definitions.joint: Stage 1: measured_only >= 3 -> report active; else report the three-point call iff exact m3 > lambda. Otherwise the policy fourth dose (choices already committed, unchanged). Stage 2: measured4 >= 3 -> report active; else report the four-point call iff exact m4 > lambda; else complete. Envelope U_d(lambda) = 0 if measured_only >= 3, else max{e3*1(m3 > lambda), max_c e4c*1(m4c > lambda)*1(measured4c < 3)}, a pointwise upper bound of every policy wrong report under the lane; lambda reselected per arm and fold by the same exact CRC rule. Wells: stage-1 lane charges the three measured concentrations, stage-2 lane adds the fourth-dose wells.
definitions.classical_rules: same saved fourth-dose choices and the same lane joint margin.
definitions.frontier: For each three-point rule the family is lane plus {exact margin > t}: lane designs are reported at every threshold. Scans over every unique non-lane exact margin (common margin, with grid and endpoints) and every unique adjusted margin (calibrated offset around the lane lambda). Operating points are the crc_obs lambdas. Matched comparisons, caps, budgets, tie rules and seed-0 bootstrap unchanged; the loop is the lane joint loop.
definitions.figure_data: Same file formats, from the lane outputs; the original no-lane outputs stay in place as the old comparator for the supplement.
